styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep-space starfield #0D1230 with glowing planet or earth horizon backdrops; dark matte panels #101736 for info cards and macro shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool cosmic studio lighting, cyan-white rim light from upper side plus soft neon glow fill, controlled soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: dark matte display pedestal and matte charcoal panel #1A2138, subtle neon glow spill on edges
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines set inside thin-line neon HUD frames
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line sci-fi HUD frames and corner brackets, single neon cyan accent #3DE8FF
styleLock.presentationRules: stable side 3/4 hero profile and consistent product scale across the set, centered placement with dark breathing space around the product
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent deep-space sci-fi streetwear sneaker visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep-space navy #0D1230, aurora indigo #2A2260, starlight white #F2F6FF and neon cyan accent #3DE8FF, with the shoe's own teal-green product accent #17977C left to the product reference; cool cosmic studio lighting with cyan-white rim light and soft neon glow fill, controlled soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines inside thin-line neon HUD frames; consistent rounded neon-outline info cards and thin-line sci-fi HUD decorations; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal neon infographic elements; stable product scale and centered placement with dark breathing space; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.textZone: top center thin-line neon HUD frame with one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #F2F6FF; bottom right one small neon badge 「{callout_2}」

The shoe photographed from a low angle at a side 3/4 profile, floating above a glowing planet horizon in a deep-space starfield, filling 50-60% of the frame. Cool cyan-white rim light from the upper right with soft neon glow fill from below, controlled soft shadow grounding the silhouette.
